definitions: f. abbess. Hkr. iii. 398, Fms. vii. 239, Gþl. 365.
m. name of a giant, answering to Gr. ̓Ωκεαξός, Edda.
að, to prevent; stefja manntjón, Fms. x. 418.
II. to address with a stave or stanza; þá stefjaði trollkona á hann ok spurði hverr þar fór (then follows the ditty), Edda 95.
u, f. a suffix indicating a lay with burdens; Rek-stefja, Stolin-stefja.
